label.purpose: Form labels, mono amounts, the destination eyebrow, category chips, timestamps.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen -- gradient orange fill, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A00 0%, #EA580C 100%); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 13px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.28); transition: transform 0.15s ease, filter 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #0F6F63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent-fill outlined button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary, #16181D); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #E4E7EC); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-hover, #F1F2F4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #0F6F63; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base surface card -- glass shadow, 1px border, 14px radius.
components.html:
Goa Trip
4 members · 12 expenses
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #E4E7EC); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(22,24,29,.06), 0 6px 20px -6px rgba(22,24,29,.12); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-primary, #16181D); } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted, #6B6E76); margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labeled text input, 16px floor to defeat iOS auto-zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-secondary, #55585E); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #E4E7EC); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text-primary, #16181D); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0F6F63; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 111, 99, 0.15); }

components.name: Passport Card
components.description: Signature trip-list card: circular stamp badge, mono destination eyebrow, dashed ticket-stub footer rule.
components.html:
Trip · INR
Goa 2026
4 travelers12 expenses
components.css: .ds-passport { position: relative; background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #E4E7EC); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.28); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-passport-stamp { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 18px; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #0F6F63; color: #0F6F63; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-passport-dest { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #6B6E76); padding-right: 64px; } .ds-passport-name { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #16181D); margin-top: 3px; padding-right: 64px; } .ds-passport-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--border-color, #E4E7EC); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary, #55585E); }

narrative.overview: Trip Tracker borrows its confidence from travel documents rather than generic SaaS chrome: a passport-style trip card carries a circular stamp badge, a mono uppercase destination eyebrow, and a dashed-rule footer that reads like a ticket stub perforation. This isn't a decorative theme bolted on top -- it's the app's own signature component (.passport-card / .pp-stamp), grounded in what the codebase already builds, not an invented overlay. Everywhere else, the system is a restrained "Linear/Stripe/Notion" neutral-gray base: one confident teal accent for structure and trust, one warm orange for the single primary action per screen. A frosted-glass header/nav floats over a live map backdrop on the trip dashboard. The system supports light mode, OS-driven dark mode, and an explicit in-app dark toggle.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral gray-scale foundation, teal for structural/brand elements, orange reserved for the one primary CTA
A travel-document motif (stamps, mono eyebrows, dashed perforated rules) as the app's recurring signature, not a one-off card
Frosted glass (backdrop-filter: blur) for floating chrome (header, nav, popups) over content, never for base surfaces
Money is always monospace with tabular figures, everything else is proportional
Full light/dark parity -- every token has a dark-mode counterpart, never a light-only afterthought

rules.name: The One Warm Color Rule
rules.body: Orange never competes with itself -- one primary CTA visible at a time. If two actions on screen both feel primary, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: Dark mode never drops to #000000; the darkest surface (#0D0E10) stays a step above true black so depth layers remain visible.

rules.name: The Money-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any rendered currency amount uses the mono family with tabular figures -- no exceptions, so a column of amounts always aligns.

rules.name: The 16px Input Floor Rule
rules.body: Text inputs never render below 16px, even where the surrounding UI runs smaller, specifically to avoid iOS Safari's auto-zoom-on-focus.

rules.name: The Glass-For-Chrome Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur is reserved for floating navigational chrome (header, bottom nav, popovers) over scrolling content -- never applied to a base page or card background.

dos: Do keep orange to one primary action per screen (The One Warm Color Rule).
Do render every amount in mono with tabular figures (The Money-Is-Mono Rule).
Do reuse the passport-card / stamp vocabulary for new travel-document-flavored surfaces before inventing a new card style.
Do keep dark mode's darkest surface a step above pure black (The No-Pure-Black Rule).
Do reserve backdrop-filter: blur for floating chrome, not base surfaces (The Glass-For-Chrome Rule).
donts: Don't introduce a third accent color family (no purple, no neon) -- the system is intentionally teal + orange only.
Don't drop interactive text below 16px in form inputs.
Don't apply frosted glass to a resting card or page background -- it's a chrome-only treatment.
Don't invent a new pill-radius value; every pill in the system is 9999px.
